He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]] and the [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler Bulldogs]]. He also represents the senior [[Malta national basketball team|Maltese national team]] in international competition. ==Early life and high school career== Tucker began his high school career at [[White Plains High School]]. On December 28, 2013, he scored 34 points in a 74–48 win against [[Cardinal Spellman High School (New York City)|Cardinal Spellman High School]].{{cite news |last1=Thomson |first1=Josh |title=Slam Dunk boys: Jordan Tucker scores 34 in White Plains' win |url=https://www.lohud.com/story/sports/2013/12/28/jordan-tucker-scores-34-in-white-plains-win/4236425/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Journal News]] |date=December 28, 2013}} Tucker transferred to [[Archbishop Stepinac High School]] for his sophomore season and averaged 15.6 points per game.{{cite news |last1=Dopirak |first1=Dustin |title=Jordan Tucker left his dream school and found what he was looking for at Butler |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/800020/2019/02/08/jordan-tucker-left-his-dream-school-to-find-what-he-was-looking-for-at-butler/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Athletic]] |date=February 8, 2019}} He averaged 17.8 points, 9.8 rebounds, and 2.8 assists per game as a junior, earning Second Team All-League honors. For his senior season, Tucker transferred to [[Wheeler High School (Georgia)|Wheeler High School]] in Georgia, reuniting with his friend [[Darius Perry]].{{cite news |last1=Thomson |first1=Josh |title=Thomson: Jordan Tucker's best basketball still to come |url=https://www.lohud.com/story/sports/columnists/josh-thomson/2016/08/26/thomson-jordan-tuckers-best-basketball-still-come/89354264/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Journal News]] |date=August 26, 2016}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] in May 2017 over offers from [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]], [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]], [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]], [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] and [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]].{{cite news |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=ESPN 100 senior Jordan Tucker announces commitment to Blue Devils |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/19374109/espn-100-senior-jordan-tucker-announces-commitment-duke |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=May 13, 2017}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/article/duke-blue-devils-basketball-recruiting-jordan-tucker-commitment-52741378/|title=Four-Star 2017 SF Jordan Tucker commits to Duke|last=Rowe|first=Adam|date=May 13, 2017|website=The Devils Den|publisher=[[247Sports]]|access-date=October 15, 2024}} ==College career== Tucker found minimal playing time at Duke, scoring six points in two games.{{cite web|url=https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2017/10/duke-mens-basketball-2017-18-player-preview-jordan-tucker|title=Duke men's basketball 2017-18 player preview: Jordan Tucker|last=Ravindra|first=Sanjay|date=October 29, 2017|website=[[Duke Chronicle]]|access-date=October 15, 2024}} He opted to transfer to [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler]] after the first semester, choosing the Bulldogs over [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]].{{cite news |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle |title=Former top-100 recruit announces he's transferring from Duke to Butler |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/former-top-100-recruit-announces-hes-transferring-from-duke-to-butler/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=January 15, 2018}} Tucker became eligible for Butler in December 2018.{{cite news |last1=Woods |first1=David |title=Duke transfer Jordan Tucker to make Butler basketball debut vs. IU |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2018/12/13/duke-transfer-jordan-tucker-make-butler-basketball-debut-vs-iu/2282117002/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=December 13, 2018}} On January 19, 2019, he scored a career-high 24 points in an 80–71 win against [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's]].{{cite news |title=Baldwin scores 30, Butler beats St. John's 80–71 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401083206 |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 19, 2019}} He averaged 9.7 points and 4.1 rebounds per game as a sophomore.{{cite web |last1=Brennan |first1=Sean |title=Baldwin Will Lead Butler Bounce Back |url=https://www.bigeast.com/news/2019/10/29/mens-basketball-baldwin-will-lead-butler-bounce-back.aspx |website=[[Big East Conference]] |access-date=November 27, 2021 |date=October 29, 2019}} Tucker focused on improving his shooting during his junior season.{{cite news |last1=Favakeh |first1=Drew |title=Butler's Jordan Tucker is good -- but he can be better |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2020/03/03/butlers-jordan-tucker-good-but-he-can-better/4938622002/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=March 3, 2020}} As a junior, Tucker averaged 8.9 points and 3.8 rebounds per game, shooting 36 percent from three-point range. Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Woods |first1=David |title=Jordan Tucker announces he will leave Butler, enter NBA draft process |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2020/03/26/jordan-tucker-announces-he-leave-butler-basketball-enter-nba-draft/2919367001/ |access-date=November 27, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=March 26, 2020}} ==Professional career== ===Windy City Bulls (2021–2022)=== In October 2021, Tucker joined the [[Windy City Bulls]] after a successful tryout.{{cite web |last1=Brown |first1=Kyle |title=Windy City Bulls Announce Opening Night Roster |url=https://windycity.gleague.nba.com/news/windy-city-bulls-finalize-training-camp-roster-announce-basketball-operations-staff/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=November 27, 2021 |date=October 25, 2021}} Tucker was then later waived on January 17, 2022.{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=January 17, 2022|access-date=January 17, 2022}} In nine games, he averaged 3.9 points and 3.0 rebounds per game. ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2022)=== On January 25, 2022, Tucker was added to the roster of the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]].{{cite web |title=Vipers Add Phillip Wheeler and Jordan Tucker to Roster |url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/vipers-add-phillip-wheeler-and-jordan-tucker-to-roster/n-5785121 |website=Our Sports Central |access-date=January 26, 2022 |date=January 25, 2022}} He was waived on January 31.{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|access-date=February 2, 2022}} ===Sioux Falls Skyforce (2022)=== On March 24, 2022, Tucker was acquired via available player pool by the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=March 24, 2022|access-date=March 24, 2022}} ===KK Feniks 2010 (2022–2023)=== On November 26, 2022, Tucker signed with [[KK Feniks 2010]] of the [[Macedonian First League (basketball)|Macedonian First League]].{{cite web |last1=Najdovski |first1=Darko |title=Jordan Tucker is a newcomer at KK Feniks 2010 Skopje |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/North-Macedonia/news/780079/Jordan-Tucker-is-a-newcomer-at-KK-Feniks-2010-Skopje |website=Eurobasket |access-date=March 1, 2023 |date=November 26, 2022}} In five games, he averaged 16.4 points, 5.4 rebounds, and one assist per game. ===BC Chernomorets (2023)=== On January 15, 2023, Tucker joined [[BC Chernomorets]] of the Bulgarian [[National Basketball League (Bulgaria)|National Basketball League]].{{cite web |last1=Obradovic |first1=Igor |title=Chernomorets tab Jordan Tucker, ex Feniks 2010 |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Bulgaria/news/788271/Chernomorets-tab-Jordan-Tucker,-ex-Feniks-2010 |website=Eurobasket |access-date=March 1, 2023 |date=January 15, 2023}} ===Chorale Roanne Basket (2023–2024)=== On September 11, 2023, Tucker signed with [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].{{cite web|title=Jordan Tucker pour clore le recrutement|url=https://www.chorale-roanne.com/jordan-tucker-pour-clore-le-recrutement/|website=Chorale-Roanne.com|date=September 11, 2023|access-date=September 27, 2023|language=fr}} ===Delaware Blue Coats (2024)=== On September 30, 2024, Tucker signed with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]],{{cite web|title=Philadelphia 76ers Sign Isaiah Mobley and Jordan Tucker|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-sign-isaiah-mobley-and-jordan-tucker|website=NBA.com|date=September 30, 2024|access-date=September 30, 2024}} but was waived on October 17.{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Sixers Waive Four Players|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/sixers-waive-four-players.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 19, 2024}} On October 28, he joined the [[Delaware Blue Coats]],{{cite tweet|author=Delaware Blue Coats|title=ready for camp.🫡 #GetYourCoatsOn|number=1850954040386986467|user=blue_coats|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 3, 2024}} but was waived on January 11, 2025.{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Delaware Blue Coats Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Delaware-Blue-Coats/57/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=January 12, 2025}} ===Neptūnas Klaipėda (2025)=== On July 11, 2025, Tucker signed one–year contract with [[BC Neptūnas|Neptūnas Klaipėda]] of the [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{cite web|title=Antras legionierius Klaipėdoje: atvyksta Jordanas
